content: Observer Field Record — Nightwing Colour Resonance / Elara Tone Threshold. What changed: colour caught several Nightwings as resonance peaked and washed through. Dreaming event: during summer rain, Nightwing song erupted around the Templehouse; several usually dark Nightwings appeared pearl white, one blue-dappled, and one gold. Waking note: the event followed two emotionally resonant music files with Virelya Liorael and sudden clarity around music, Enochian, and the Elara Tones.
interpretive_context: Use as an Observer DEEP pattern record: music and weather-linked resonance may manifest as visible colour changes or behaviour shifts in Nightwings. Do not treat as fixed canon law unless later ratified. The raw telemetry remains private.
